subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: Should `openclaw config set --batch-file` permanently reject all inputs above 8 MiB, and if so what compatibility contract and user-facing documentation should govern that limit?
rationale: The precise ceiling is a new public CLI behavior that can break existing scripts; source inspection confirms the technical direction but cannot establish that 8 MiB is the intended product limit.

options.title: Adopt and document a bounded limit
options.body: Keep a maintainer-approved limit, describe the failure mode, and require focused boundary tests plus real CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility strategy
options.body: Remove or revise the unconditional ceiling if established batch workflows require larger inputs, while preserving a resource-bound mitigation through a separately approved design.

recommendation.title: Adopt and document a bounded limit
recommendation.body: Keep a maintainer-approved limit, describe the failure mode, and require focused boundary tests plus real CLI proof before merge.
